name: AttributeEditor
title: Templates/Platform/Edit/AttributeEditor
summary: A key/value editor, drawn as a variables list page and the Create Variable drawer its heading action opens. Each variable is entered as a pair of `InputGroup` rows, a Key row with a Remove button and a Value row with a show-value button and a Secret checkbox, beside a Form or JSON view and an Upload of a .env file; every scope is an `InputGroup` joining its label, a `MultiSelect` of resources and an enable `Switch`, with Global giving way to any specific scope. Required and invalid states appear only after Save is pressed. An account with no variables renders the first-use empty state in place of the list. Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `TableRoot`, `Card`, `CopyButton`, `Avatar`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Input`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Drawer` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `InputGroupRoot`, `InputGroupAddon`, `Checkbox`, `ToggleGroup`, `MultiSelect`, `Switch`, `HelperText`, `Hint` and `Button`; the JSON view is a webkit `Textarea`.

variants.name: Create
variants.summary: Closed until Create Variable opens it: one empty Key and Value pair, the Form view selected and Global the only scope switched on, all reset each time the drawer opens. Save flags the empty or malformed fields only after it is pressed.
